placements.title: Verified calibration holds across the full operating range
placements.theme: Once an instrument's calibration is checked against a trusted reference, it can be trusted to hold across its entire operating range.
placements.why: Quill Ashgrove asserts the Kestrelwood spectrograph's 88.4 MHz calibration was verified against the June reference plates and holds across the full observing band — a directional claim about calibration reliability that future calibration envelopes for this or other instruments will keep feeding, not a one-off fact. It nests under the org's existing Calibration strata category, which exactly covers this content, so no lineage or standalone mint of the strata itself is needed.
